notes: Launch-day (2026-10-07) third-party board coverage sweep for claude-haiku-5-5, same shape as sonnet-5-5-board-coverage-2026-09-28. Method: raw HTML by curl with a browser User-Agent for static pages and for the data embedded in them (Artificial Analysis and tbench.ai embed their table JSON in the page; Vals, SEAL, Steel and Epoch render rows server-side), and the Playwright browser for the client-rendered ARC Prize and DeepSWE pages. Only AA, OpenRouter and llm-stats list Haiku 5.5 on launch day; llm-stats has no scores. Every other board has no Haiku 5.5 row, which is expected on day zero. Absences are provisional: recheck on or after 2026-10-14. Unlike the Sonnet 5.5 sweep, these absences were read from table content, not from search snippets, except that SEAL, Steel and Epoch were read from static HTML and could differ from the live client view. The AA pages do not say whether the runs used a pre-release deployment (no AA article yet). livebench.ai returned a 1 KB JavaScript shell and was not checked. Same-snapshot roster rows from the boards that did not list Haiku 5.5 are in third-party-board-roster-refresh-2026-10-07.json.

claims.statement: OpenRouter: LISTED. Model anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5 (canonical slug anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5-20261007, created 2026-10-07T18:31:23Z per the models API). List price $0.10 input and $0.50 output per M tokens; cache read $0.01, cache write 5m $0.125, cache write 1h $0.20; above 100,000 prompt tokens the listed price is $0.50 input / $2.50 output (cache read $0.05, write 5m $0.625, 1h $1.00). A ':batch' variant lists half of each rate. Context 1,000,000; max completion 128,000; input text, image and file; tokenizer field 'Claude' (same label as Haiku 4.5, so it does not show a new tokenizer). Reasoning: not mandatory; supported efforts max, xhigh, high, medium, low; default effort 'medium'. (Sonnet 5.5 on the same API: mandatory reasoning, default 'high'.) OpenRouter's description: 'It is the first Haiku model with adjustable effort. Thinking is adaptive and on by default, with effort as the main lever for trading off depth, latency, and cost; it can be turned off at low, medium, and high effort.' Five providers at the list price (Google Vertex, Claude Platform on AWS, Azure, Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock), plus five Vertex/Azure/Bedrock endpoints at $0.11/$0.55 that are not used in standard routing. Throughput 83 to 183 tok/s and latency 0.33 to 2.32 s across endpoints (P50, launch day). The alias ~anthropic/claude-haiku-latest now points to Haiku 5.5. Checked 2026-10-07 from the models API, the endpoints API and the model page.
claims.implication: OpenRouter is a price and availability listing, not a quality board: confirm the >100K price tier, the default effort and the thinking-off option against Anthropic's own docs (Lane A). The listed prices agree with the secondary press reports ($0.10/$0.50, and $0.50/$2.50 above 100K tokens).
